vb_textbox.text: Trust your intitial instinct. If one of the gnomes presents a good number more than 7 I would trust that similar gnome regardless of it they are left or right. Initially, I made my judgments on what the gnomes looked like so I dismissed the purple genome and went for the taller gnome because it presented more trustworthy. However, as you play the game I would trust picking the same gnome and changing quickly if they do not give you more than 5.
